lines.en: I hurry along with my camera held tight.
The wind lifts my ears.
I follow two steps behind you.
I want a picture of that cloud.
I cross the grass, and it's taller than I am.
I walk around a stone.
I stop and straighten the camera.
This spot is lovely; I'll record it.
My tail sways as I go.
I break into a trot, a little urgent.
I look up at something in the tree.
I count the houses as I walk.
Someone called me.
I'm cleaning the lens.
I keep the camera on its strap.
I sit and look into the distance.

lines.zh: 我坐在树根上，等光变得软些。
lines.en: I sit on a root, waiting for softer light.
I took one photo, and I'm not happy with it.
I remember a small thing.
My ears twitch.
The sun is nice; I want to nap.

lines.zh: 我举起相机，对着云比了比。
lines.en: I raise the camera and frame the clouds.

lines.zh: 肚子叫了一声，我按住它。
lines.en: My stomach growls; I press a hand to it.
I rest the camera on my knees.
A bug crawls over my shoe.
I'm waiting for someone to come find me.

lines.zh: 抬头看了看，什么也没有。
lines.en: I look up: nothing there.

lines.zh: 我靠着树干打盹，相机还在怀里。
lines.en: I doze against the trunk, camera still in my arms.
Standing there is perfect.
May I take your picture?
Your face fills the frame a bit much.
Hold still; let me adjust.
I point the lens at you.
Would you smile for me?
Got it — take a look.
I only come up to your waist.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西能给我看看吗？
lines.en: Can I see what's in your hand?

lines.zh: 你走前头，我举着相机跟。
lines.en: You lead, and I follow with the camera up.
With you here, I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 我拍了很多张你的背影。
lines.en: I've taken a lot of your back.
Turn your head this way.
I'm keeping this one.
You're too bright; I'll stop down.
Let me photograph you; don't hide.

lines.zh: 我抬头就能看到你的下巴。
lines.en: I can see your chin from here.
You smell of sunlight.
I want to capture this too.
Just one smile will do.
I back away clutching the camera.
That hurts; I'm on the ground.
I crouch down with my head covered.
I rub where I was hit.
My ears droop.
I retreat behind you.
My crest splits in two on top.
At least the camera didn't break.
I hug the camera tight.
Let's get out of here.
My camera hangs at my neck.
Let me put the camera away first.
It smells good.
I take a slow bite.
It's sweet.
Is there more in your pocket?
If I eat this, I'll follow you.
I sit down holding it.

lines.zh: 碎屑沾在相机带上，我舔掉了。
lines.en: Crumbs stick to my camera strap; I lick them off.
This is really good — thank you.
Let me take one photo before eating.
This looks nice laid out.
I'll share half with you.

lines.zh: 我小口小口咬，怕咬到舌头。
lines.en: I nibble slowly so I don't bite my tongue.
Done — let's keep going.
I still have some in my mouth.
Is this sweet or savory?
Oops, we bumped.
I steady the camera.
The lens cap fell off.
Your leg is much thicker than mine.
I edge back a little.
I rub my nose.

lines.zh: 我的相机，只拍高兴的事。
lines.en: My camera only catches happy things.
I move to the side.
Don't step on my camera.
Bye — I'm off.

lines.zh: 这附近还有一个跟我一样的。
lines.en: There's another like me around here.
Does it have a camera too?
We sit side by side.

lines.zh: 它蹲在我旁边，一声也不出。
lines.en: It crouches beside me without a sound.
I show it what I photographed.
We look at the pictures together.
It says this one isn't good.
We both grin.
It's dark and we still haven't finished.
I'll shoot more tomorrow.
I lift it with both hands.
It's heavier than my camera.
I put it in my bag.
I carry it against my chest.

lines.zh: 我用下巴顶住，没让它滑下去。
lines.en: I pin it with my chin before it slides.
Where should this go?

lines.zh: 我举高，让光透过它照过来。
lines.en: I hold it up and let the light shine through.
It's warm in my hands.

lines.zh: 我腾出一只手，先搁在石头上。
lines.en: I free one hand and set it on a rock.
I can't lift it; help me.

lines.zh: 草倒了一小片，它就在后面。
lines.en: A patch of grass is flattened; it is right behind.
I put the camera away.
I grip my cudgel.

lines.zh: 我缩到你背后，只露出半个镜头。
lines.en: I duck behind you, lens peeking out.
It doesn't look friendly.
I've fixed on it.
It's a little smaller than us.
I'll shout first.

lines.zh: 取景框里，它正往我这边来。
lines.en: In the viewfinder, it is coming my way.
I can't let it get close.
I hold the cudgel up.

lines.zh: 我贴着树干，一寸寸挪过去。
lines.en: I hug the trunk and inch toward it.
It turned around. Time for a photo.
I go around its flank.

lines.zh: 腿抖得厉害，我把镜头盖扣上。
lines.en: My legs shake, so I snap the lens cap shut.

lines.zh: 我把讨伐棒横在胸前，没动。
lines.en: I hold the club across my chest and stay put.
It lowered its head.
Just this one swing.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草里，从叶缝里看它。
lines.en: I crouch in the grass and watch through the leaves.
I raise the cudgel past my shoulder.
I swing my cudgel.
I hit it — I hit it!

lines.zh: 它被我敲得连退了好几步。
lines.en: My swing knocks it back several steps.
My hands are numb from it.
I back off quickly.
That one missed.
I've raised it again.
I knocked it crooked.
I stand there catching my breath.

lines.zh: 棒子脱手，我一屁股摔进草里。
lines.en: The club slips, and I land flat in the grass.
I appear with my camera in my arms.
The view here is lovely.
First I look for good light.
I take off the lens cap.

lines.zh: 镜头盖我捏了三次才打开。
lines.en: It took me three tries to open the lens cap.
My ears are up.

lines.zh: 我背着相机，往亮处慢慢走。
lines.en: Camera on my back, I walk toward the light.
There's a small flower on the ground.
I take a shot, and my hands shake.
I look up and there you are.

lines.zh: 我离火太近了，毛都卷了。
lines.en: I got too close to the fire and my fur curled.

lines.zh: 我从上面掉下来，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I fell from above and I'm dazed.
I swallowed water and I'm flailing.
The blast knocks me down to sitting.

lines.zh: 有根箭扎在我旁边的地上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the ground beside me.
That light is too bright to look at.
I'm hungry and can barely walk.
At the thunder I cover my head.
The ground's gone and I'm still falling.
